apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Metal 4 cleanup removes the experimental presentation bridge, renderer overrides, developer HUD and per-frame diagnostic disk traces. Preserves direct CAMetalLayer residency, MetalFX, HEVC 10-bit 4:4:4 HDR, normal stats, error reports and input/navigation fixes. Frame generation remains absent. Release build, 331 automated tests and 165 GPU checks pass. Physical build-150 regression pending; build 149 remains the verified block-free baseline. Unsigned build for installer signing.
